name: Dynamic Publishing-Standard Report Synthesis Swarm
description: Multi-agent swarm for report planning, graph-first document reviews, and sliding-window cross-analysis refinement.

variables.topic: Strategic implications of local model alignment standardizations
documents: The TOGAF Standard, 10th Edition - Introduction and Core Concepts.md

outputs.spec: Focus topic: ${topic}. Target length: ${word_count_target} words. Structure: Introduction, Reviews of ${documents}, Cross-Analysis, and Conclusion.

tasks.description: Planner Agent: Decompose focus topic '${topic}' into a structured outline targeting a length of ${word_count_target} words. Write the approach, methodology, and the Introduction section of the report.

Document Analyst: Read and analyze each document in the list ${documents} targeting focus topic '${topic}'. Execute graph first queries (`query_graph`) to extract structured concepts from the pre-loaded knowledge graph, falling back to document scan (`read_file`) and vector RAG (`search_kb`) if needed, producing compiled individual reviews.

Synthesizer Agent: Execute cross-document analysis comparing findings from document_reviews to surface higher-order insights, synthesis patterns, and contradictions related to '${topic}'. Ensure the combined findings exceed the sum of the individual parts.

Publishing Editor: Refine the combined draft section-by-section using sliding window constraints to ensure consistency, flow, and that the final output satisfies the target length of ${word_count_target} words, writing the final result to '${output_file}'.

metadata.notes: Single-laptop optimized report swarm. Documents are pre-loaded in the default workspace. Target word count is specified dynamically.
